title: Design System: KKB Site Diary privacy pages

title.purpose: Sections of the notice and deletion instructions.

review.purpose: Open checks within the draft notice.

components.name: Text link
components.description: Underlined link with hover and keyboard focus styles.
components.css: .ds-link { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #064f91; text-underline-offset: .2em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-link:hover { color: #12344f; text-decoration-thickness: .15em; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #064f91; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-link { font-size: 1rem; } }

components.name: Page navigation
components.description: The two privacy-page links wrap when needed.
components.html: Privacy noticeDeletion instructions
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1.5rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-nav a { color: #064f91; text-underline-offset: .2em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #12344f; text-decoration-thickness: .15em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #064f91; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-nav { font-size: 1rem; } }

components.name: Draft warning
components.description: Solid-bordered draft status shown near the page title.
components.html: Draft for KKB review — not approved for publication. This notice covers controlled testing within approved test projects.
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.7; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #927119; background: #fff8dd; color: #43320b; margin-block: 1.5rem; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-status { font-size: 1rem; } }

components.name: Review note
components.description: Dashed-bordered paragraph for an open review point.
components.html: Review required: Verify that account permissions and location controls enforce this policy. This draft does not confirm that those controls are installed.
components.css: .ds-review { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; padding: .75rem 1rem; border: 1px dashed #927119; background: #fff8dd; color: #43320b; margin: 0 0 1rem; }

components.name: Skip link
components.description: Keyboard link that appears when focused.
components.css: .ds-skip { position: absolute; left: 1rem; top: -10rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; background: white; color: #064f91; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.7; text-underline-offset: .2em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-skip:hover { color: #12344f; text-decoration-thickness: .15em; } .ds-skip:focus { top: .5rem; } .ds-skip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #064f91; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 420px) { .ds-skip { font-size: 1rem; } }

narrative.overview:
The user selected a simple text-only page. The page uses one reading column, dark system text, a white background and blue underlined links. It has no images or motion.

This record describes the built pages in `index.html`, `data-deletion/index.html` and `styles.css`. It does not give legal approval. The draft warning and open review notes remain part of the page.
keyCharacteristics: Clear draft warnings and review notes.
dos: Do keep the single reading column and system font.
Do keep links underlined and keyboard focus visible.
Do show the draft warning and open review notes while checks remain open.
Do use the existing shared styles on both pages.
donts: Don't add images, motion or a new visual style to this text-only brief.
Don't add buttons, forms or cards that the pages do not use.
Don't present this design record as legal approval or permission to publish.
